from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import math, struct, io, os

ICON_DIR = ''/c/Users/henri/Projets/ragkit_desktop/desktop/src-tauri/icons''

def draw_loko_icon\(size\):
    """"""Draw the LOKO keyhole icon at any size.""""""
    img = Image.new\(''RGBA'', \(size, size\), \(0, 0, 0, 0\)\)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw\(img\)

    # Scale factor relative to 48x48 viewbox
    s = size / 48.0

    # Rounded rectangle background
    margin = 3 * s
    rect_size = 42 * s
    corner_r = 13 * s
    
    # Draw filled rounded rectangle
    x0, y0 = margin, margin
    x1, y1 = margin + rect_size, margin + rect_size
    draw.rounded_rectangle\([x0, y0, x1, y1], radius=corner_r, fill=\(15, 125, 99, 255\)\)
    
    # Add subtle gradient overlay \(lighter at top\)
    overlay = Image.new\(''RGBA'', \(size, size\), \(0, 0, 0, 0\)\)
    overlay_draw = ImageDraw.Draw\(overlay\)
    for y in range\(int\(y0\), int\(\(y0 + y1\) / 2\)\):
        alpha = int\(255 * 0.16 * 0.9 * \(1 - \(y - y0\) / \(\(y1 - y0\) / 2\)\)\)
        if alpha > 0:
            overlay_draw.line\([\(int\(x0\), y\), \(int\(x1\), y\)], fill=\(255, 255, 255, alpha\)\)
    # Mask overlay to rounded rect
    mask = Image.new\(''L'', \(size, size\), 0\)
    mask_draw = ImageDraw.Draw\(mask\)
    mask_draw.rounded_rectangle\([x0, y0, x1, y1], radius=corner_r, fill=255\)
    overlay.putalpha\(Image.composite\(overlay.split\(\)[3], Image.new\(''L'', \(size, size\), 0\), mask\)\)
    img = Image.alpha_composite\(img, overlay\)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw\(img\)
    
    # Keyhole - circle
    cx, cy = 24 * s, 20.2 * s
    cr = 6.1 * s
    draw.ellipse\([cx - cr, cy - cr, cx + cr, cy + cr], fill=\(255, 255, 255, 255\)\)
    
    # Keyhole - teardrop/triangle part
    # Path: M21.1 24.4 L19.3 32.6 a4.9 4.9 0 0 0 9.4 0 L26.9 24.4 Z
    # Simplified: a trapezoid from \(21.1, 24.4\) to \(19.3, 32.6\) then arc to \(28.7, 32.6\) then \(26.9, 24.4\)
    top_left = \(21.1 * s, 24.4 * s\)
    bot_left = \(19.3 * s, 32.6 * s\)
    bot_right = \(28.7 * s, 32.6 * s\)
    top_right = \(26.9 * s, 24.4 * s\)
    
    # Draw the trapezoid body
    draw.polygon\([top_left, bot_left, bot_right, top_right], fill=\(255, 255, 255, 255\)\)
    
    # Draw the arc at the bottom \(semicircle with radius 4.9*s\)
    arc_cx = 24 * s
    arc_cy = 32.6 * s
    arc_r = 4.7 * s
    draw.ellipse\([arc_cx - arc_r, arc_cy - arc_r, arc_cx + arc_r, arc_cy + arc_r], fill=\(255, 255, 255, 255\)\)
    
    return img

# Generate all needed sizes
sizes = {
    ''32x32.png'': 32,
    ''64x64.png'': 64,
    ''128x128.png'': 128,
    ''128x128@2x.png'': 256,
    ''icon.png'': 1024,
    ''Square30x30Logo.png'': 30,
    ''Square44x44Logo.png'': 44,
    ''Square71x71Logo.png'': 71,
    ''Square89x89Logo.png'': 89,
    ''Square107x107Logo.png'': 107,
    ''Square142x142Logo.png'': 142,
    ''Square150x150Logo.png'': 150,
    ''Square284x284Logo.png'': 284,
    ''Square310x310Logo.png'': 310,
    ''StoreLogo.png'': 50,
}

for filename, sz in sizes.items\(\):
    icon = draw_loko_icon\(sz\)
    path = os.path.join\(ICON_DIR, filename\)
    icon.save\(path\)
    print\(f''Generated {filename} \({sz}x{sz}\)''\)

# Also generate the app-icon.png \(main source\)
app_icon = draw_loko_icon\(1024\)
app_icon.save\(''/c/Users/henri/Projets/ragkit_desktop/desktop/app-icon.png''\)
print\(''Generated app-icon.png \(1024x1024\)''\)

print\(''Done!''\)
")
